name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
tagline: High-precision injection-moulder that has become a picks-and-shovels supplier of GLP-1 pen injector devices to 23-24 global pharma partners ahead of the semaglutide patent cliff - exceptional returns profile (ROCE 29-42%, ROE 27-33%) but already a ~Rs 14,000 Cr mid-cap trading rich, with a genuine oral-GLP-1 cannibalisation debate and recent promoter selling
business_overview: Vadodara-based contract manufacturer of injection-moulded precision plastic components and sub-assemblies across three segments - Consumer (IKEA-anchored homeware, ~55% of revenue, slow-growing), Healthcare (drug-delivery devices, the growth engine) and Industrial. The Healthcare vertical makes IP-led pen injectors / auto-injectors for GLP-1 drugs (generic semaglutide/tirzepatide) and has ~23-24 global pharma partners lined up for patent expiries in India, Canada and Brazil (from 2026). Pen capacity being scaled 80M -> 150M/year, plus a ~Rs 300 Cr Abu Dhabi medical-device facility (75M pens, live Q4FY28). Early work on consumer-electronics and semiconductor precision components as a further leg. (Source: trusted-x, @unseenvalue dedicated single-stock writeup, non-negative tone, first_seen 2026-09-07; scan tier 4.55, no conviction floor.)
fundamentals_table: Q2FY26 +34% YoY, Q3FY26 +27% YoY (9M +32%); Healthcare +163% YoY in Q2FY26
Q2FY26 gross 59.3%, EBITDA 31.8% (vs 21.5% YoY), PAT +134% YoY
Rich; UBS initiated Buy Dec-25 with Rs 4,000 TP citing 96% Healthcare revenue CAGR FY25-28
fundamentals_narrative: One of the cleanest return profiles in the screen - trailing ROCE ~29% stepping to a 42% spot exit rate as the high-margin Healthcare mix scales and machine utilisation improves (47.7%, +560bps YoY). Revenue growth has been 27-34% for the last several quarters with EBITDA margin expanding ~1,000bps YoY on operating leverage plus mix. Balance sheet is comfortable (D/E ~0.34). The catch is valuation - the stock has compounded hard, sits near its 52-week high at a rich multiple, and the whole re-rating is discounting a GLP-1 device ramp that carries a live cannibalisation risk from oral GLP-1 (Novo's Wegovy pill launched in the US Jan-26; orforglipron pending). Q3FY26 showed the first QoQ wobble (small revenue dip, ~5pp OPM drop) that prompted a 'is the story trimming down?' thread debate.
technical_read: Not pulled - the assessment turns on valuation and the oral-pill debate, not on chart position; near 52-week high is already known.
sentiment_summary: 277-post thread, most recent post 2026-06-29. Community is broadly constructive on the GLP-1 device opportunity but with an active, high-quality bear debate: oral semaglutide/orforglipron cannibalising injectables, India generic GLP-1 offtake being slower than expected (Nithin Kamath / press cited), and promoter stake sale flagged as a worry in the last two posts. Bulls (BuyRightSitTight, nil_71, idikasony, rajvinder.singh - a 7-year holder calling management 'honest and conservative') frame Shaily as a classic picks-and-shovels play where the device is needed regardless of which pharma wins, and note OneSource is fully booked. UBS Buy (Rs 4,000) and Capital Group bulk-buying (Mar-26) are external validation.
community_signal: No core-tier (phreakv6) call. Marathondreams (elevated) posted factual competitive-landscape updates (Zydus single-pen device) without a directional call. General tenor from long-term holders is positive-but-watchful. The @unseenvalue Substack writeup that seeded this (trusted-x, 'high' strength) is an analytical piece framed around whether Shaily's edge is 'specific knowledge or a patent', non-negative.

trusted_signals.note: Dedicated single-stock analytical writeup on Shaily's precision-moulding edge and the GLP-1 device opportunity, non-negative tone. trusted-x tier 4.55, x_conviction_strength high. A vetted tip, not a conviction floor.

bse_notes: No SEBI or fraud action found. Promoter stake sale in recent months noted by forum members as a sentiment negative; Capital Group added via bulk deals Mar-26. No going-concern or auditor issues.
bull_case: Picks-and-shovels exposure to the GLP-1 super-cycle - 23-24 pharma device partnerships, capacity 80M -> 150M pens plus a 75M-pen Abu Dhabi plant
Exceptional and improving returns - trailing ROCE ~29%, spot 42%; EBITDA margin +1,000bps YoY on mix and operating leverage
Consistent 27-34% revenue growth with Healthcare compounding ~96% (UBS estimate FY25-28)
Long-tenured, conservative, well-regarded management; institutional validation (UBS Buy Rs 4,000, Capital Group buying)
Optionality in consumer electronics / semiconductor precision components where few Indian players can compete
bear_case: Oral GLP-1 (Wegovy pill live in US, orforglipron pending) could cap or shrink the injectable-pen TAM the entire re-rating is built on
Valuation is rich - near 52-week high, well above the screen's comfort zone; little cushion if the ramp disappoints
Q3FY26 was the first QoQ revenue + margin dip after years of sequential growth - bears asking if the story is trimming
India generic GLP-1 offtake running below expectations; Shaily's growth leans on export partners executing on schedule (DRL approval delays already caused a double-digit single-day drop)
Promoter selling into strength; Consumer segment (still the majority of revenue) barely growing
At ~Rs 14,000 Cr market cap the 10x-in-2-3-years / 100x-in-10-years math does not work without further heroic multiple expansion from already-rich levels
verdict_headline: A genuinely excellent business and a clean trusted-X lead, but a ~Rs 14,000 Cr mid-cap already trading rich, with a real oral-pill overhang and promoter selling - four-box score permits a return label, but the size and valuation math do not. thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Medium; better suited to a quality-compounder bucket than the max-returns screen.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind yes (GLP-1 device demand + 2026+ patent cliff is a strong multi-year pull), tam yes (global injector market, 23-24 partners, 150M+ pen capacity, innovator tie-up and semiconductor optionality; mid-cap with room), moat yes (high-precision moulding capability few domestic players have, IP-led pens, regulated-market qualification barriers - though device supply is partly commoditisable), valuation weak (rich, near 52-week high, P/E well above screen comfort even on forward Healthcare growth) -> score 3.5

Score 3.5 permits a 10x/100x label, but it is not mandatory - exercising judgment: at ~Rs 14,000 Cr a 10x in 2-3 years needs ~Rs 1.4 lakh Cr, and 100x in 10 years is not credible for a device contract-manufacturer; combined with the oral-pill cannibalisation risk and promoter selling, the honest call is 'neither' for this screen while acknowledging Shaily is a high-quality compounder worth tracking

Live-theme match: 'GLP-1 / peptide supply chain' (priority 2) via pen device / injector keywords - the screen note flags studying the supply side, which is exactly where Shaily sits; value_chain block written
No red flag. Source is trusted-x (@unseenvalue, high) - Step-3 filter passed on merits anyway; no conviction floor (core/phreakv6 only)
Re-check trigger: Q4FY26/Q1FY27 Healthcare revenue run-rate and pen volumes vs the 30-35M FY26 guidance; evidence on whether oral GLP-1 is denting injectable-pen order books; further promoter selling

value_chain.position: Device / drug-delivery layer - makes the pen injectors and auto-injectors that generic semaglutide/tirzepatide players need; sits between the API/fill-finish companies (e.g. OneSource, DRL) and the branded/generic marketers. Complementary to fill-finish, not competing with it.
value_chain.pricing_power: Moderate - IP-led / patented pen designs and regulated-market device qualification give some pricing power and stickiness, but multiple global device makers exist and large innovators could in-source; margins so far protected by mix and scarcity of Indian precision-moulding capacity
value_chain.bottleneck_exposure: Positive - injectable GLP-1 volume growth and the 2026+ patent cliff create a device-supply pull; the risk is the bottleneck easing if oral formulations take share from injectables

four_box.note: Strong GLP-1 device tailwind and TAM, real precision-moulding moat, but valuation is rich near the 52-week high; score permits a return-magnitude label which judgment declines to apply given ~Rs 14,000 Cr size and the oral-pill risk

market_expectation.gap_basis: the patent-cliff device volume ramp is partly in the 90x; the oral-GLP-1 cannibalisation risk and promoter selling cap it, but 23-24 signed partners is a real commercial signal

track_record.note: Of FY23-FY25 (both metrics verifiable), only FY25 (+22.2%/29%) cleared. FY23 (+6.9%/14%) and FY24 (+6.1%/20%) missed - FY23-24 revenue growth was ~6%. The GLP-1 device ramp lifted FY25-26 growth to 22-26%; FY26 ROCE not yet disclosed.
